mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a one-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, increasing the likelihood of earnings downgrades and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 for two months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 660.0 thousand units after two consecutive months below 650.0 signals renewed housing market confidence, boosting consumer wealth and aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 227.0 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 10k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters, combined with a contraction in industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, increasing the probability of corporate earnings cuts and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% YoY and INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
